items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: But a Cuban guy? Excuse me, thank you.

ctx.x: Thank you for sharing that. These producers, film producers should listen to your “Second Trumpet Concerto,” that’s what I think.

For me that has been very difficult to have opportunity here in L.A. I live in L.A. for fourteen years. The main reason we moved from Florida to L.A., it was exactly for that, looking for opportunity to write scores. Because it’s probably my biggest passion within the music, writing scores for movies. I love that. I love that more than I can say. And I didn’t have enough opportunity in fourteen years. I did a few movies, a few, very few. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

But that’s the thing you know, some people, you know they say oh yeah you need some finesse or something, da-da-da. Okay. Look for some guy from France or Germany or Italy. You understand what I mean? But a Cuban guy? Excuse me, thank you. I still make my living and I shouldn’t complain. I don’t want you getting a wrong concept of how my soul feels you know. And I’m extremely grateful, I’m just telling you what I really feel about all the things, but those things I try my best don’t affect me in general, and…
